messages:
anya: FYI we kicked off bring-up for sable-v2-int8 (streaming + funcall workloads). initial smoke shows structured-output compliance regressions on tool calls.
marco: what's the delta vs raven baselines? numbers?
lina: overall parse-fail ~1.9% vs 0.7% on raven-v4-prod. breakdown: 60% suffix garbage (JS comments, trailing tokens), 25% truncated escapes, 15% unexpected top-level keys.
zane: unexpected keys? example?
lina: sample: `{"operation":"charge","params":{...},"extra_meta":{"tag":"beta"}}`  our validator is v2-schema which doesn't allow `extra_meta`.
anya: we also saw cases where the model emits an envelope wrapper: `{"payload": {"action":...,"params":...}, "schema_version":"2a"}`  that's new and breaks function binding.
marco: was schema_version added by model or by preprompt? could be a new instruction template.
lina: it's in raw model output, not prompt. probably new calibration during distilled fine-tune.
zane: two risks: 1) changing output format means funcs won't match; 2) quantization/codec artifacts create suffix/fragments.
nora: suggestion: introduce a thin pre-parse adaptor: detect common envelopes (payload, body, result) and unwrap to expected {action,params}. For trailing-comment suffixes, strip JS-style `/*...*/` and `//...` when they appear after a valid JSON object. Log raw output to S3.
marco: agree to unwrap common envelopes in CANARY only. But need guardrails: only unwrap if inner object validates against function contract; otherwise keep strict.
nora: also recommend adding a `Schema-Version` response header in the canary harness so we can correlate outputs to model checkpoints.
anya: routing/retries note: retry budget spikes observed; when a retry lands on a different replica, KV cache changes and the model emits different continuation, sometimes producing duplicate trailing tokens that break parsing. We should sticky-route retries for 8s keyed by request-id.
zane: implementable. Also add metrics: toolcall.parse_failure.{suffix,truncate,envelope,unknown_key} and tag with model= sable-v2-int8 and quant=int8.
lina: I'll add unit tests that feed envelopes and comment-suffix variations: cases = [payload-envelope, body-envelope, trailing `/*...*/`, trailing `// note`, dangling comma in array].
anya: rollout plan: 1) canary adaptor (unwrap+strip) + sticky routing + sampling of raw failures -> QA cluster 10% traffic for 8h. 2) A/B with strict parsing on control. 3) if parse-fail drop to baseline and no adverse latency, expand.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/canary-envelope-adaptor -> qa cluster @ 2026-03-21T16:00Z :rocket:
marco: one more: do not auto-accept new top-level keys in prod. whitelist only `meta`/`metadata` and `schema_version` for metadata inspection, but keep strict binding to function name/params.
anya: noted. I'll wire dashboards and an alert: sustained toolcall.parse_failure.envelope > 0.4% for 1h.
zane: will add sticky-routing change to infra PR and test mirror affinity.
marco: will post canary metrics here once live. :thumbsup:
